- Update the **ticket status** to "Resolved" in the customer portal/internal system.
- Leave a **customer-facing note** (e.g., email or in-app message) with:

Your failed migration fee refund of [240] has been processed and will reflect in your account within [X days/approval timeline]. Let us know if you need further assistance."*

---
**3. Documentation**
- Add a **ticket closure log** with:

  - Refund request submission details (ID/reference # if provided).
  - Any customer communication sent (e.g., email ID, in-app message link).
  - Notes on delays (if any) or escalations required.

---
**4. Escalation Path (If Needed)**
- If the refund is **rejected** or the region **cannot be updated**:
  - Reopen the ticket and notify the **planner** (add note: *"Region/update failed; requires manual intervention"*).
  - Provide screenshots/system logs of the error.
